title: Flash backup 7.1 - the cooker's main board wired for the clip read
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~46 px/mm in this crop)
caption: Supply through break-out A on J8. The reset hold from TP33 to GND at JP5 pin 2, on before power. The clip on U15 (pin 1 at the dots), five leads to the reader, no VCC lead. J14 position 3 as the optional SOP2 strap. The close-up is picture 7.2.

terminals.label: Bench supply + (5.0 V, OVP 6 V, limit 100 mA): break-out A header pins 1-6
Bench supply -: break-out A header pin 30
Reader (Pi, Pico or FT232H): CS, CLK, MOSI, MISO, GND; drawings fb-reader-*

callouts.label: U15: the clip, pin-1 lead on pin 1 (the dots)
callouts.note: Leads on pins 1, 2, 4, 5, 6; none on 3, 7, 8. Pin map: picture 7.2.

callouts.label: TP33 = U1's nRESET: the hold probe
callouts.note: To GND before power and for the whole read (J-203, J-204).

callouts.label: R321: its right pad is 3.3 V, never the probe
callouts.note: Left pad = nRESET, right pad = 3V3 (J-204, J-205, J-208).

callouts.label: JP5 pin 2, GND: the hold lead's ground
callouts.note: The round pad; GND (J-080). JP5 pin 1 below it stays free: the supply comes through J8.

callouts.label: J8: break-out A, the supply only
callouts.note: Header pins 1-6 = VIN (U17's input), 30 = GND (J-077, J-078, J-089, J-201); every other header pin open. The cooker's own cable stays out.

callouts.label: J14 pad 3 (common, 270 Ohm to 3.3 V)
callouts.note: Optional SOP2 strap with pad 6 (J-200): if the hold slips, the ROM only waits. Two probes joined by a lead, if they fit beside the clip.

callouts.label: J14 pad 6 = SOP2 (X6)
callouts.note: Pad 6 to X6: from the mosaic (J-098); beep it once (J-200).
